about.title: Precision built, strength earned
body: Target Fitness Center is built for people who train with purpose — chalk on the floor, plates that get loaded, coaching that actually corrects your form instead of just counting reps.
We don't do fluff. Every program here is built around getting measurably stronger, and every member is expected to put in real work — but never alone.

faqs.question: Is CrossFit scaled for beginners?
faqs.answer: Yes — every WOD has a scaled track, and your first class is always free.

faqs.question: Do you offer month-to-month membership?
faqs.answer: Yes, all memberships are month-to-month with no cancellation fees.

faqs.question: What gear do I need?
faqs.answer: Just gym clothes and shoes with a flat sole. Chalk, bands, and all barbells/plates are provided.

faqs.question: Is there a minimum age?
faqs.answer: Members must be 16 or older; 16-17 year olds need a parent or guardian to sign a waiver.

faqs.question: Can I drop in without a membership?
faqs.answer: Yes, single class drop-ins are available at the front desk for visiting athletes.

blogPosts.title: Fat Loss Isn't Complicated, It's Just Uncomfortable
blogPosts.excerpt: The blunt version of what actually works — and why intensity matters more than people admit.
blogPosts.author: Theo Banks
content: Nobody wants to hear this, but fat loss is mostly a consistency problem wearing a nutrition costume.
You need a real calorie deficit, enough protein to hold onto muscle, and enough intensity in training to make the deficit worth it.
Track your weekly average, not your daily number. One bad day doesn't undo a good week, and one good day doesn't fix a bad month.
Pick a program hard enough to respect and simple enough to actually finish. That's the whole secret.

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.body: We collect the information you provide when you sign up for membership or contact us — name, email, phone number, and billing details necessary to process payments.

sections.heading: How we use it
sections.body: Your information is used to manage your membership, communicate about classes and schedule changes, and process payments. We do not sell member data to third parties.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You can request a copy of the data we hold about you, or ask us to delete it, at any time.

sections.heading: Membership terms
sections.body: Memberships are billed monthly, month-to-month, with no cancellation fees.

sections.heading: Facility use
sections.body: Members are expected to re-rack plates, use chalk responsibly, and follow posted class capacity limits.

sections.heading: Liability
sections.body: Strength training and CrossFit carry inherent risk. Members are responsible for training within their own limits and consulting a physician before starting a new program if needed.
